paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles from X-ray observations of Hydra galaxy cluster
notes: Paper constrains axion-like particle (ALP) coupling to photons using X-ray observations of Hydra A galaxy cluster with Chandra. Main result: g_agamma < 8.3×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for ALP masses below 7×10^-12 eV. For higher masses (7×10^-12 to ~2×10^-11 eV), the exclusion curve rises as m_a^2 due to increasing critical energy. The constraint is derived from absence of spectral irregularities expected from photon-ALP oscillations in the cluster's turbulent magnetic field. Conservative analysis using measured magnetic field profile from Faraday rotation.
